title: "Mortality convergence in Europe? Spatial differences in life expectancy gains between 1995 and 2019"

[***Population and Development Review***]{.journal} · 2024

\[[Article](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/padr.12657)\]

> *Using annual e0 estimates for 420 regions in 16 EU countries from 1995 to 2019, we examined whether regions with initially high mortality levels caught up with low-mortality regions. Mortality variation has generally decreased over the period, but in more recent years some advantaged regions realized further gains while improvements slowed for more disadvantaged regions.*
